Decree honouring the fathers of Heraclea. Marble. 130s-140s AD.
This is honorific decree for the ambassadors, who were sent by Heraclea, metropolis of Chersonese, to Rome, to Emperor Antoninus Pius (138-161 AD) asking for help for the city. Although centuries passed from the time when the colonists had left Heraclea to found Chersonese, this decree called Heraclea the "progenitor" city.
